subject: Invoice submission — preferred channel & onboarding form fields
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@greenstonethera.com>
To: jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@greenstonethera.com
Date: Sat, 02 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding questions — invoice delivery and PO mapping

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the kickoff yesterday. We want to get our finance team aligned for go-live next month and have two quick questions so we can finish our vendor setup:  

1) Is Redwood's portal the preferred ingestion path, or can we simply send invoices to a billing email? Our AR system prefers SMTP, but we can use the portal if there are advantages.

2) On the onboarding form we saw a single "PO number" field — Greenstone issues POs per legal entity. Do you need a separate line for each PO or a single PO field with an entity code?

I've attached our draft onboarding form and a sample invoice. If you can point to the exact fields Redwood requires (and any subject token you prefer), we'll update our AP team.

Appreciate a short note or a 15-min call if that's easier.

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Vendor Manager — Greenstone Therapeutics
Attachments: Greenstone_Onboarding_Form_v1.pdf (application/pdf), sample_invoice_stub.pdf (application/pdf)

From: jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@greenstonethera.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com, kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sat, 02 Aug 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding questions — invoice delivery and PO mapping

Elena — thanks for the clear note and the attachments. Quick answers below, and copying Vanessa (Vendor Ops) and Kimberly (AP integrator) to confirm technical details / SLA.

1) Preferred path: Portal by default. Pros: idempotency, automatic PO matching, subject-token free routing, and faster acknowledgements. Email (billing@redwoodinference.com) is allowed as a fallback for smaller batches or legacy systems, but it requires stricter filename/subject conventions and our team needs to manually triage mismatches which can add 24–48h to processing.

2) PO mapping: Please include one PO per invoice row. Since you have multiple legal entities, use the onboarding form's "billing_entity" dropdown for the invoice-level entity and include the entity code in the invoice filename as: ENTITYCODE_PO12345.pdf. We will use the combination to route and match.

Action items for Greenstone:
- If you can switch to the portal, tick "portal-first" in the onboarding form and we'll provision a company-level account + sample API/web UI access.
- If you must email, use subject: INVOICE GFN:<ENTITYCODE>:<PO#> and filename pattern: ENTITYCODE_PO<PO#>_inv<YYYYMMDD>.pdf

Vanessa / Kimberly — can you confirm the portal onboarding flow timeline (how long to provision) and whether we need a separate merchant token per legal entity?

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Senior Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com
To: jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com, Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@greenstonethera.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 04 Aug 2025 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding questions — invoice delivery and PO mapping

Hi all — quick operational clarifications from Vendor Ops:  

- Provisioning timeline: Portal account + sandbox test credentials: 2 business days after we receive the completed onboarding form with company legal name, tax ID, and primary AP contact. Production provisioning: additional 3 business days after sandbox acceptance.

- Entity handling: We prefer a single company portal account with entity sub-IDs (no need for separate merchant tokens unless the customer requests separate reporting/ledgers). For PO matching we support two options:  
  * Preferred: invoice-level metadata includes "billing_entity": "GREEN-NE" and one PO per invoice row. Our matcher then reconciles against the PO list for that sub-ID.
  * Alternate (email fallback): include ENTITYCODE in filename + subject token as Jordan specified; we'll run filename-parsing rules. Note this will be processed with lower SLA and potential manual intervention.

- Required fields on the onboarding form (please populate these): legal_name, tax_id, billing_entity (select from dropdown), primary_ap_email, remit_address, currency, PO_matching_mode (line_by_line | invoice_level).

- Sample files: we prefer XLSX with line items split per row (quantity, unit price, tax, line-level PO). PDFs are acceptable but will require OCR in the fallback queue.

Elena — if you attach the completed onboarding form, I will queue sandbox credentials and a sample acknowledgement mapping for your AP system.

Vanessa Ortiz
Vendor Onboarding Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@greenstonethera.com>

Thanks Jordan and Vanessa — that's exactly the clarity we needed. Attached is our completed onboarding form with the billing_entity codes filled and a revised sample invoice exported as CSV (per your guidance). We'll select portal-first.

A few quick notes for tracking:  
- Greenstone will expect sandbox credentials to be sent to ap_integration@greenstonethera.com.
- For PO numbering we will standardize the filename to: GREEN-NE_PO67890_inv20250731.csv going forward.

Attaching: Greenstone_Onboarding_Form_v1.pdf (completed), sample_invoice_stub.pdf (CSV export included inside PDF wrapper).

Best,
